reviewText:
# Cold ProcessRows reexecution review

Reviewed the current mounted c05aa394 + 0d583613 implementation, captured
immutably in input/ with exact SHA256 values in INPUTS.json. No Root or author
files were edited. This is independent source review; I did not run Core or
count Parent's actual gates as my own execution.

No actionable output-substitution, skipped-fatal-path, omitted-original-
boundary or rejected-owner head-publication defect was found in this scope.

The public expectation supplies archive/foundation/head pins and complete
historical metadata pins, not financial state or returned validity values.
inspect_archive first checks the independently expected archive digest,
foundation/head, canonical commands, exact physical chain and framing
(checkpoint lines 131–198). Reexecution admits only raw ProcessRows entries
before creating finance (historical replay lines 49–59), reexecutes one actual
SourceContractReplay foundation (81–86), and binds its client/namespace and
original source-index origin (112–145). The current Post index is moved once;
historical views are read from its actual journal rather than imported rows.

The row bridge invokes the same source_main_process_rows_iter and same source
decode/Logic/mark prefix. Its callback receives id/type/valid/reason computed
by that source execution. Recorded find/update failures run through the
actual shared failure counters (historical rows 41–70). A genuine update
throw is returned to the existing outer source catch, which performs its
original fatal mark and second validity call; it is not normalized to success.

The metadata verifier recomputes actual first-suffix selection and mutation
bytes against the historical Before. It permits pre_update only to return a
real throw, advances no boundary on rejection/no-match, and compares complete
KV plus directory bytes before consuming a successful Post (historical
validity 66–135). Boundary sequence increments/publication/context are checked
at open. The page-only overlay shares the exact mutation helper: live writes
read only the selected page, while cold playback reads that page from the
verified old view. It does not replace the live path with a full snapshot.

For every command, replay separately checks the original physical Before/Post
against both the prior command and archived physical record (160–164). It
requires playback exhaustion, computes ordered effects, validity observations,
financial commitment and logical receipt from execution, compares all encoded
receipt bytes, then checks the final logical and physical heads (175–228).
The recorded receipt is a comparison target, never an execution backend.

On any mismatch/local stop, the result is the distinct rejected-owner type,
retaining the current locked index and any actual financial prefix. Its
financial view and computed prefix receipts are read-only diagnostics; there
is no mutable Replay escape, into_session, success head getter or retry that
can reinterpret that rejected prefix as an accepted Session. A successful
Session is constructed only after all receipt/head/current-pin checks pass.

## Five actual-Core tests inspected

| Test | What it establishes in its written assertions |
| --- | --- |
| historical_actual_source_rebuilds_finance_from_raw_foundation_and_original_file_history | Two original commands, real second processed skip, exact state/head/archive, unchanged current metadata and append bytes. |
| historical_actual_live_source_rebuilds_same_true_result_without_past_append | Actual live raw0 result and reconstructed state/archive; no supplied validity outcome. |
| historical_bad_boundary_retains_current_owner_without_financial_state_import_or_head_escape | Corrupt original boundary rejected before finance; prefix empty and real writer lock retained. |
| historical_empty_native_history_reexecutes_only_raw_foundation | Empty native history reconstructs the genuine foundation exactly. |
| historical_actual_failure_facts_reexecute_fatal_validity_without_supplied_verdicts | One and two actual injected update failures retain both original validity observations and reproduce the fatal source prefixes/state/archive. |

These are five bounded cases, not proof of arbitrary transaction/exception
domains. The four metadata controls additionally test a wrong computed
validity flag, two writes with no-match/rejection interleavings, first-suffix
selection, extra writes and skipped sequence rejection. I found no concrete
uncovered implementation defect warranting a new adversarial overlay.

The domain remains completed ProcessRows history in one available retained
publication. It does not implement active-service/catchup/timer cold replay,
partial-command process-death recovery, pruned-generation reconstruction,
arbitrary source domains or chain/actor authorization. Independently retained
pins establish relative integrity, not authentication.
